lemma royaltyB (hD' : D'.ε≤1/4) : ∃ B : ℝ→ℝ, Rate G L (-(1/2)) B ∧ ∀ᶠ s in atTop,
    ∀ (c f:Side) (S : StepData c f) (T : Tube G S), S.patch=D → Works P L s S T →
    ∀ (R : Rep G f) (Q : ConnectedActivityE6.Target G P) (μ α:ℝ) (H:Cash W s μ L Q o α T R),
    ∀ (F : Forest S.ratio) (X : Coat T F) (i : ℕ), H.supportP (Opacity.key S i)=yFoot S (R.activities.reg i).support s Q.halo →
    X.x=s → X.width=o.K→X.χ=χ→ X.manifest → ∀ (P':BudgetPoint), P'.B=radiusB s→ P'.power=p → Plays C D' P' R.p P T s →
    ∀ (Y : Support c) (I:Type) [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] (a : Museum F X.x (bareStores S) (R.activities.reg i).support Y I) (q : Chi) (b τ : ℝ), ∀ y∈Y,
    coverNumber (radiusB s) Y ≤ radiusB s → Healthy P'.threshold Y X.V → Scrim X a →
    R.p.supBounds (R.activities.reg i).site (R.activities.reg i).support (R.activities.E i) τ → τ ≤ incomingE G L s →
    ∀ j ≤ n, ∀ U : Slab G c j, (∀ i,P'.dirBound y (U i))→ (∀ i, ‖U i‖ ≤ canopyW G L p s) →
    let V:= journey X.V j U
    let g x:= Shield.bars (podium S G Y X.B) (vary X (V x)) {Opacity.key S i} R Q.table W o.a Q.halo
    let u:= a.hymn T (gStep R.beta) q b X.k (R.activities.E i) (Baffle.magic D' R.p R.beta κ) 1
    Brush n (τ*|B s|) 1 (fun x=> g x+u (V x)) 0 := by

proof_context.conclusion: `royaltyB` bounds the local integrand `g + u` by `τ*|B s|` in the normalized derivatives, where `g` is the actual part and `u` the Gaussian principal part.
